dialogues.speaker: Libuse
dialogues.text: Hey, did you hear what Big Sis Hidimbi said? She said there've been sightings of the supposedly-sunken Atlas out at sea lately...

dialogues.speaker: Mahla
dialogues.text: I did! There's no way it's true, is it? She even told me the ship's full of treasure from Snezhnaya. Why, if only there was a way to get my hands on some of that...

dialogues.speaker: Libuse
dialogues.text: Mahla, my dear! Please don't even think about that! Even if there's treasure on that ship, it's not something we should have anything to do with...

dialogues.speaker: Libuse
dialogues.text: What is it that the Frostmoon Scions say? That ship was cursed by something out at sea, and only someone as bold as Big Sis Hidimbi would come into contact with it... or persuade others to.

dialogues.speaker: Mahla
dialogues.text: That's true... I'll tell my husband to be more careful when he goes out to sea. What if there really is a ghost ship...?
